name: Saionji Karin
source:
A relative of the president's wife, she is an idol who has been asked to appear exclusively in the company's commercials. She has a bright and innocent personality.

She is being courted by the producer who discovered her, and although she hates him, she is not yet ready for a full-fledged relationship.
In fact, she is an exhibitionist who gets sexually aroused by being seen.

When she is molested by the protagonist while riding the train with no panties on, her sexuality is awakened by his hands.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/7549]official site[/url]]
